attempts.text:
The plan rescues the two shopkeepers at Tadi farm, the two pensioners at Galchhi farm, and the three cooperative members at Kakani village, plus four of the six labourers at Dupcheshwar market. The remaining two labourers are deferred. The only evacuation points are Jwalamukhi shelter and Gosaikunda hospital, so all rescued people end up at one of those.

<plan>
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter tadi-farm
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 tadi-farm jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
drive car2 gosaikunda-hospital galchhi-farm
load car2 elderly 2
drive car2 galchhi-farm gosaikunda-hospital
unload car2 elderly 2
drive car2 gosaikunda-hospital kakani-village
load car2 adult 3
drive car2 kakani-village gosaikunda-hospital
unload car2 adult 3
drive car2 gosaikunda-hospital kakani-village
drive car2 kakani-village dupcheshwar-market
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 dupcheshwar-market kakani-village
drive car2 kakani-village gosaikunda-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
defer dupcheshwar-market adult 2
</plan>

COST: 194
